verdicts.reason: Both use the same banner reflow: stripes on the left, then the box, headline, and subcopy stacked above the CTA on the right. Their flaws are similar: the box straddles the stripe/lime seam awkwardly, and the 48H badge is tiny and jammed against the left edge. A's badge is partly clipped at the left edge, and its CTA pill crowds the right edge. B's box corner overlaps the pink badge, an unwanted collision, though B leaves a better right margin. I picked A by a slim margin because a clean badge beats a collision.
